title: carol joins, then alice plays, optimized

timeline.label: carol joins. `len` is a word on the stack. `name` has no copy: its place is the call's own bytes, found through a word in memory.
alice plays. `player` gets a place: a copy of her record, in memory.
The optimizer inlined `_applyCombo`. Inside it, only its own locals are in scope, and `mult` has no place yet.
`mult` gets a place: 8 bytes of memory.
`mult = combo` made no copy. `mult`'s place is now `combo`'s own bytes: one place, two names.
Back in `play()`. `_applyCombo`'s locals are out of scope, and `gained` gets a place.
